name: Ashnisha Industries Ltd
about: Incorporated in 2009, Ashnisha Industries Ltd trades various steel products and goods[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2]
a) Manufacturing and trading of Steel and Steel alloys
b) Trading and Investment Business
c) Trading of Software, Electronic and IT Product
d) Trading of Goods

cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Promoter holding has decreased over last quarter: -10.7%
The company has delivered a poor sales growth of -29.0% over past five years.
Company has a low return on equity of 1.20% over last 3 years.
Earnings include an other income of Rs.5.28 Cr.
Company has high debtors of 561 days.
Working capital days have increased from 1,665 days to 3,411 days
